title: Copy-loop instruction by phase
statement: For a natural number $K_0$, let the source and destination be registers among $17$ registers, let $e$ be an exit label, let $m$ assign a label to each of seven phases, and let $j$ be one of those phases. Define the instruction at phase $j$ as follows: at phase $0$, test whether the source register is zero, branching to phase $4$ if it is and phase $1$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement the source and proceed to phase $2$; at phase $2$, increment the destination and proceed to phase $3$; at phase $3$, increment register $0$ and proceed to phase $0$; at phase $4$, test whether register $0$ is zero, branching to $e$ if it is and phase $5$ otherwise; at phase $5$, decrement register $0$ and proceed to phase $6$; and at phase $6$, increment the source and proceed to phase $4$.
